verdict.text: 5 problems App Review or App Store Connect turns away, and 5 warnings to review

findings.title: Purpose string missing
findings.message: AVCaptureSession (Ledger/ScannerView.swift:6) needs NSCameraUsageDescription (camera); Ledger has none.

fix.title: Add the key in the target's Info tab
steps: In Xcode, select the target, open Info, and add the key with a sentence that says what the app does with the data. Xcode stores it as the INFOPLIST_KEY_<key> build setting.
If the app never uses this feature, remove the code or the package that uses it instead.

sources.title: Apple: Requesting access to protected resources

fix.title: Write a one-sentence string
steps: Set the INFOPLIST_KEY_<key> build setting (target > Info in Xcode) to one complete sentence that says what the app does with the data.

sources.title: Apple: Adhere to the requirements for purpose strings

findings.title: App Store icon has an alpha channel
findings.message: The App Store icon has an alpha channel.

fix.title: Export the icon without transparency
steps: Export the 1024 × 1024 icon as an opaque PNG: give it a solid background and turn off "Transparency" or "Alpha" in the export settings (in Preview: File > Export, untick Alpha).
Check it with: sips -g hasAlpha path/to/icon.png (it should print hasAlpha: no).

sources.title: Apple Developer Forums: Icon composer icon contains alpha channel upload error (the 90717 message, with a DTS engineer)
Apple: Human Interface Guidelines, App icons

findings.title: Xcode older than App Store Connect accepts
findings.message: .xcode-version pins Xcode 16.4 (.xcode-version); App Store Connect accepts uploads built with Xcode 26 or later since 28 April 2026.

fix.title: Build with Xcode 26 or later
steps: Change the pinned version to Xcode 26 or later (for example 27.1) in the file and line the finding names, and use a runner or build image that has it.
Fix the build warnings and errors the newer SDK reports before the next upload.

sources.title: Apple Developer News: Upcoming SDK minimum requirements (3 February 2026)

findings.title: Deployment target below iOS 13
findings.message: Ledger targets iOS 12.0; App Store Connect accepts iOS apps that target iOS 13.0 or later since 9 September 2026.

fix.title: Raise the deployment target
steps: Set IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET of the app target to 13.0 or later (target > General > Minimum Deployments in Xcode), and raise platform :ios in the Podfile to match.
Remove the code paths that only ran on older iOS versions.

findings.title: Purpose string is placeholder or default text
findings.message: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription "TODO: explain location" contains the placeholder "TODO".

fix.title: Say why the app needs access
steps: Replace the text with one sentence that names what the app does with the data, for example "Take a photo of your meal to log it" rather than "needs camera access".

sources.title: Apple: Adhere to the requirements for purpose strings

findings.title: Export compliance not declared
findings.message: The Info.plist of Ledger has no ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption, so App Store Connect asks the export compliance questions for every build.

fix.title: Declare the app's encryption
steps: Set the INFOPLIST_KEY_ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption build setting to NO if the app uses no encryption or only exempt encryption such as HTTPS, or to YES with ITSEncryptionExportComplianceCode otherwise.

sources.title: Apple: Complying with Encryption Export Regulations

findings.title: Account creation without account deletion
findings.message: Accounts are created (a createUser(withEmail:) call in Ledger/SignUpView.swift:13), and no account deletion call or "Delete account" text was found in the app's code or strings.

fix.title: Let people delete their account in the app
steps: Add a Delete account action that is easy to find, usually in the account settings, and that deletes the account record with its personal data, not only deactivates it.
If deletion finishes on a website, link straight to that page. With Sign in with Apple, also revoke the user's tokens.
If the app already has it under words reviewready does not know, turn the finding off with --ignore RVW301.

sources.title: Apple: Offering account deletion in your app

findings.title: Third-party login without an equivalent option
findings.message: Google Sign-In is used (import GoogleSignIn in Ledger/SignUpView.swift:1), and no Sign in with Apple was found: no package, entitlement or AuthenticationServices call.

fix.title: Offer Sign in with Apple next to the other login
steps: Add Sign in with Apple (AuthenticationServices on iOS, sign_in_with_apple on Flutter, expo-apple-authentication or @invertase/react-native-apple-authentication on React Native) and the Sign in with Apple capability.
If the app falls under one of the exceptions of guideline 4.8, or offers another login service with the listed features, turn the finding off with --ignore RVW401.

findings.title: Privacy manifest not in the app
findings.message: Ledger/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is not in the Copy Bundle Resources of Ledger or in a folder it syncs, so the app ships without it.

fix.title: Add the file to the app target
steps: Select PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in Xcode, open the File inspector and tick the app target under Target Membership, so it appears in Build Phases > Copy Bundle Resources.
